retrievalProfile.description: A split-frame urban layout featuring a high-contrast portrait leaning against a pillar on the left and bold stencil typography over an industrial background on the right.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical split composition where a male subject in casual-formal attire leans against a brightly lit concrete pillar on the left, while the right side features a dark, industrial underpass with massive, white stencil-cut typography layered over the structural shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against vertical pillar anchor
Typography integrated into the dark negative space of the underpass
High-key lighting on the left contrasting with low-key industrial depth on the right
Horizontal lines of the parking lot and overpass leading the eye toward the subject
coreInvariants: Stencil-style gaps in the primary display font
High-contrast lighting with blown-out highlights on the pillar
Industrial urban setting with concrete and asphalt textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left third of the frame, full-body portrait from knees up, leaning against a vertical pillar.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical concrete pillar acts as the primary divider and anchor for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright subject on the left, moves right to the large white typography, then follows the perspective lines of the underpass into the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, shadowed area of the underpass provides high-contrast negative space for the white text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows in the underpass
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for typography and pillar highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm tan and denim blue from the subject's clothing
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the overexposed pillar and the underexposed background; low saturation overall with a gritty, cinematic tint.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical stencil gaps (bridges) placed centrally in vertical and curved strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and U feature vertical breaks at the top and bottom centers
S features diagonal breaks in the spine
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large stencil display font paired with a widely-tracked, smaller geometric sans-serif for contrast in scale and density.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule-like spacing created by the subtitle text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton and bold weight.
Provides the necessary industrial stencil aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an urban scene with a man in a corduroy blazer and jeans leaning against a bright, overexposed concrete pillar on the left. The right side should show a dark, shadowed underpass with perspective lines from a parking lot and bridge structures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay large white stencil-cut uppercase text in the top right dark area. Insert a smaller line of widely-spaced sans-serif text between the two main display words.

verificationChecks: Ensure the pillar is significantly brighter than the background
Check that stencil gaps are visible in the display text
Verify the split-frame balance between subject and text
Confirm the wide tracking on the subtitle text

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the overexposure on the pillar
mustRedesign: Avoid specific facial features of the original artist
Do not use the exact brand logos or specific album titles
Ensure the stencil gaps are clean and intentional, not weathered

mustAchieve: Sharp contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Is the text legible against the dark background?
Does the subject look naturally integrated with the pillar?
Are the stencil gaps consistent across all display letters?
Is the lighting direction consistent across the scene?
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Concrete Pillar Anchor + Dark Underpass Negative Space + Stencil Typography Overlay
